ideas.pitch: An AI-powered voice translation tool built with Google AI Studio that translates regional Indian dialects into formal English and vice versa in real time.
ideas.title: LocalLingo: Regional Dialect AI Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at Google Developer Groups Gurugram judges by leveraging Google AI Studio heavily for nuanced multilingual understanding.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool that ingests messy PDF syllabi or lecture slides via Google AI Studio and instantly outputs interactive flashcards and adaptive quizzes.
ideas.title: StudySprint: AI Syllabus-to-Quiz Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable pain point for students and beginners participating in the hackathon, making the demo instantly engaging.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first AI assistant using Google AI Studio that allows rural farmers to ask crop health and weather questions in conversational Hindi and receive localized advice.
ideas.title: AgriSathi: Farmer Advisory Voice Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at regional tech events value social impact combined with accessible AI integration for non-technical users.

ideas.pitch: An AI career companion that grades beginner developer resumes and GitHub READMEs against job descriptions, outputting actionable bullet-point fixes using Google AI Studio.
ideas.title: ResumeRefiner: AI Portfolio and CV Roast
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly appeals to the beginner-friendly 'Anybody Can Code' ethos of the event by helping new developers get job-ready.

ideas.pitch: A rapid prototyping tool where users upload a hand-drawn UI sketch on paper and Google AI Studio converts it into clean, responsive HTML and Tailwind code instantly.
ideas.title: QuickSketch: Wireframe-to-Code Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly leverages Google Stitch and rapid prototyping tools emphasized in the hackathon description to showcase instantaneous value.
